name: BLE-02 断连 → onAppShow 缓存直连（不重扫）

setup.code: if (!globalThis.__bleMock) throw new Error('ble-mock 未注入'); return globalThis.__bleMock.getState();

steps.code: const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p.data.devices[0]; if (!d) throw new Error('设备列表为空：扫描未发现 ML-8DCC'); return p.onTapDevice({ currentTarget: { dataset: { deviceId: d.deviceId, name: d.name } } });
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { route: p.route, deviceId: p.data.deviceId, connected: !!p.data.connected, error: p.data.error || '' };
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const r = await p.requestToken(); return { granted: !!r.granted, reason: r.reason || '' };

const st = globalThis.__bleMock.getState(); const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { scanCount: st.scanCount, connectionCount: st.connectionCount, connected: !!p.data.connected };
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { connected: !!p.data.connected, reconnecting: !!p.data.reconnecting };
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const r = await p.requestToken(); return { granted: !!r.granted, reason: r.reason || '', connected: !!p.data.connected };
